title: GPUI cold glyph outline preflight/raster audit
scope: Read-only source and pinned dependency audit. No source edits, builds, tests, or timings.

pinned_dependency_facts.implication: Replacing Swash can remove its Skrifa 0.44 edge, but cannot remove read-fonts 0.41 while Fontique 0.12.0 remains. Therefore do not claim elimination of the older parser stack as a whole.

primary_upstream.finding: Swash main manifest is version 0.2.10 and constrains its Skrifa dependency to <=0.44.
Fontique release metadata identifies read-fonts ^0.41.0; the workspace lock pins Fontique 0.12.0 to read-fonts 0.41.0.
Skrifa documentation describes its layer above read-fonts and its outline support; pinned local Skrifa 0.49 Cargo manifest/lock use read-fonts 0.46.0.

cold_miss_sequence: Parse face via Skrifa 0.49, locate glyph outline, reject draw_memory_size(Hinting::None) > 1 MiB, then fully draw unhinted into BoundsPen.

After full walk: map DrawError to InvalidFont first; then invalid/nonfinite/out-of-range geometry to InvalidGeometry; then >65536 line/quad/cubic segments to ResourceLimit. Bounds use control hull and floor/ceil.
Reject conservative raster area >1 MiB, then potentially clear cache before rendering.

Parse same bytes with Swash 0.2.10 / Skrifa 0.44, scale outline into Swash-owned points/verbs, and render through Zeno 0.3.3 Mask to Alpha. Check content, actual image byte limit/length, and y placement; insert pixels in cache.
ordering_observations: Preflight glyph absence/draw-memory limit happen before outline traversal; DrawError precedes pen flags; invalid geometry precedes segment cap.
Estimated image cap is before pre-render cache clear; that cache clear precedes Swash render and can therefore occur even if rendering then errors.

A second preflight outline walk is certain at the source level for a cold raster miss. This does not establish two complete machine-level parser walks after optimization; no emitted-artifact claim was measured.
ink_bounds independently calls outline_bounds, so repeated ink-bounds queries add another full current-Skrifa outline draw each time.

single_outline_feasibility.borrowed_view: No direct zero-copy route found. Skrifa OutlineGlyph is a lazy decoder exposing draw-to-OutlinePen, not a PathData view. Swash Render::render_into has no API accepting that view: it clears its private outline, calls scale_outline_impl, then passes the resulting path to Zeno Mask.

pinned_local_source.fact: draw_memory_size is documented as temporary memory required to draw; OutlineGlyph::draw emits through OutlinePen.
Render::render_into clears private outline, scale_outline_impl decodes to it, then Zeno Mask rasterizes its path.
Swash Outline owns points, verbs, and layer ranges; path() borrows those vectors.
Zeno Mask accepts PathData and renders into supplied output; Swash publicly reexports Zeno.

single_outline_feasibility.materialized_view: A current-Skrifa recording OutlinePen can collect f32 points and verbs once, update exact bounds/validation/segment counters in that callback, then borrow the vectors as Zeno PathData. This eliminates the second outline decode/draw at source level, but adds a path buffer (or reuses one), changes the rasterizer path from Swash to direct Zeno, and may change pixels because current raster uses Skrifa 0.44 while the recorded path uses 0.49. No speedup or pixel identity is established.
single_outline_feasibility.memory_caveat: The existing 1 MiB draw_memory_size limit bounds decoder scratch, not the materialized recording vectors. Segment cap bounds line/quad/cubic commands only; move_to calls do not increment it. A recorder must preserve all moves and define a separate defensible byte/command bound or prove a font-byte-derived bound. Avoid early exit at segment 65537 because current order still validates and fully decodes before returning ResourceLimit, and later DrawError/InvalidGeometry precedence must remain the same.
single_outline_feasibility.zeno_match: Direct Zeno with identical path bytes, Alpha format, BottomLeft origin, NonZero style, zero offsets, and sizing should be the closest rendering match; identity is a hypothesis until differential pixel fixtures cover all supported outline formats and transforms.

representations_considered.name: A. Keep current Swash render; retain preflight
representations_considered.cost: One Skrifa preflight parse/draw plus Swash/Skrifa 0.44 outline scale/draw-to-buffer, followed by Zeno path sizing/raster passes. No new path cache; Swash owns/reuses points and verbs in scaler state. Existing error order and pixel path remain.
representations_considered.decision: Safe baseline; reject as a work-elimination change because it removes no source-level outline decode walk.

representations_considered.name: B. Record current Skrifa outline once, then direct Zeno Mask
representations_considered.cost: One current Skrifa decode/draw into reusable vectors while BoundsPen checks; then Zeno reads path for bounds/sizing and raster (at least a second path iteration). Adds reusable points+verbs storage and capacity-retention accounting; can remove Swash dependency and Skrifa 0.44, not Fontique/read-fonts0.41. Raster may differ from current Swash/Skrifa0.44 output.
representations_considered.decision: Only plausible direct one-decode route. Recommend a narrowly gated prototype after defining byte/command limits and preserving error precedence; no merge recommendation until exact raster and cache/error behavior tests pass.

representations_considered.name: C. Keep Swash scaler, expose its owned outline for checks and Zeno rendering
representations_considered.cost: One Swash/Skrifa0.44 decode into owned path, inspect same path, then Zeno Mask. Could preserve path/raster implementation closer than B; needs API/fork because Render owns private outline, plus migration of preflight semantics/version. Cannot use current Skrifa0.49's draw_memory_size check on Swash0.44 decoded path without retaining a second parser/check path.
representations_considered.decision: Reject as-is: wrapper/API patch alone does not preserve current Skrifa0.49 resource and error semantics. Consider only with supported Swash update to 0.49 and differential proof.

representations_considered.name: D. Upgrade or adapt Swash to Skrifa0.49 and fuse BoundsPen into outline collection
representations_considered.cost: Potentially keeps existing Swash rasterizer while capturing the path and preflight facts during its existing decode, then rasterizing that path. Requires a maintained Swash fork/upstream API and compatibility audit; current upstream Swash manifest caps Skrifa at 0.44. A path buffer is still retained, and Render's normal API alone still re-decodes unless refactored to accept the collected path.
representations_considered.decision: Architecturally attractive if upstreamable, but not a dependency-only version bump and not a small safe change in the current pinned graph.

renderer_alternatives.parley_fontique: Parley/Fontique provide text layout, font discovery and fallback, not a replacement mask rasterizer for this path. Fontique maintains read-fonts0.41, so it also blocks a whole-stack parser deletion claim.
renderer_alternatives.cosmic_text: Not a drop-in preservation route: its current crate graph uses its own Skrifa/Swash versions and exposes a higher-level text system; using it would change layout/raster/cache contracts rather than simply fuse the same outline passes. No migration advantage established.
renderer_alternatives.vello_glifo: Glifo accepts positioned glyph runs and caches glyph preparation; Vello's current CPU/GPU Sparse Strips architecture consumes vector/path geometry, with a different rendering and caching contract. It is not a drop-in pixel-preserving replacement for a cached Alpha mask. Official Vello architecture distinguishes CPU/GPU Sparse Strips from experimental compute renderer and Glifo text support.

smallest_recommendation: Do not change production based on the source audit alone. If eliminating a cold outline walk remains a priority, prototype B in an isolated branch: one bounded reusable recording pen with the existing exact Skrifa0.49 settings and check/error ordering, then Zeno0.3.3 Mask over its slices. Make the path buffer's retained capacity explicit in RasterCache limits and clear_cache. First prove byte-for-byte raster equality against current Swash for representative glyf/CFF/CFF2/variable outlines, empty/no-area glyphs, contour-only and move-heavy fonts, and hostile malformed/large paths; also prove unchanged Error results and cache clearing order. Only compare warmed/one-shot timings after those semantic gates pass. If exact pixels fail or storage caps perturb error behavior, retain current path.
acceptance_conditions: Differential masks and placement are byte-identical for supported unhinted formats, sizes, variation locations and all checked fonts; otherwise document/reject behavior change.

Error variant and ordering fixtures cover malformed outline, draw-memory cap, NaN/Inf/coordinate limit, 65536/65537 segments, move-heavy contour cases, estimated-area cap, actual-size cap and cache clear before a backend failure.
Recorder capacity is explicitly bounded/charged, reset/reused without stale commands, and not retained outside the intended cache/scaler lifecycle.
Exactly one current-Skrifa OutlineGlyph::draw occurs per cold cache miss in source instrumentation; emitted-code claims require artifact inspection, not source inference.
Benchmark cold raster miss separately from repeated cache hit and ink_bounds calls; no speed claim from fewer source calls alone.
claims_not_made: No machine-code or optimizer behavior inspected.
No source modified; no build or test run.
